title: Appeals and Grievances Training Sheet: Inpatient Cost-Share Percentage on a Line Joining an Allowable Charge Review
content:
Appeals and Grievances training sheet: the inpatient cost-share percentage on the joining line

For a further paid TRICARE Select inpatient line joining the Allowable Charge Review already filed on its claim.

Rule: The cost-share percentage on the joining line follows the facility's network status recorded on the joining line and the inpatient schedule of the tier the stay is billed under: a non-network facility under a tier whose non-network inpatient basis takes a percentage of the allowed amount carries that tier's non-network inpatient percentage; a network facility under a tier whose network inpatient basis is the lesser of a daily charge and a percentage carries that tier's network inpatient percentage; any other carries no percentage.

The tier is the TRICARE Select tier of the enrollment the stay is billed under; its inpatient bases and percentages are the figures in the TRICARE Select schedule. A non-network inpatient basis takes a percentage of the allowed amount when it is a percentage-of-allowed basis or a lesser-of basis comparing a daily charge with a percentage. "Non-network" covers a facility recorded as non-network, participating or nonparticipating.

*A network facility, and the tier's network inpatient basis is a per-admission copayment. What percentage?* None; only a network facility under a lesser-of basis carries the network inpatient percentage.

*A non-network nonparticipating facility, and the tier's non-network basis is a hypothetical 25 percent of the allowed amount.* 25 percent, the tier's non-network inpatient percentage.

*A non-network facility, and the tier's non-network basis is the lesser of a daily charge and a percentage.* The tier's non-network inpatient percentage: that basis also takes a percentage of the allowed amount.

| Facility recorded as | Tier's inpatient basis for that status | Cost-share percentage |
|---|---|---|
| non-network | percentage of the allowed amount | the tier's non-network inpatient percentage |
| non-network | lesser of a daily charge and a percentage | the tier's non-network inpatient percentage |
| non-network | daily charge with a minimum | none (0) |
| network | lesser of a daily charge and a percentage | the tier's network inpatient percentage |
| network | daily charge with a minimum, or a per-admission copayment | none (0) |
